This isn't your typical invasion!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 6 ([[Huevous Hunt]], Hard)}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' was a fast enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Huevous Hunt]] as part of [[The Hunt Event]]. It had a high amount of health, higher than the [[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt)|Korblox Warrior]], and a quick speed for its health, having similar speed to the [[Korblox Soul (The Hunt)|Korblox Soul]]. Additionally, on some waves, it had the stun and freeze immunities, making it harder to slow down. It also sometimes had the [[Burn Immunity]], making it immune to being set on fire. ==Appearance== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' had tan and blue skin. It wore full body armor, which consisted of a helmet, chestplate, leggings, shoulder-pads and shoes. This armor was split into two halves. The first half is based around the armor worn by the Redcliff faction, while the second by the Korblox faction. The Redcliff part was colored red and gold while the Korblox part was colored dark blue and grey. The Korblox part also had multiple dark blue and blue horns on it. The emblems of the two factions were also visible on its armor. ==Strategy== *Due to its fast speed and high health, high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended against it. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate and range of towers respectively. *Stalling towers like the [[Freezer]] or [[Warden]] can be useful at slowing down the '''Redcliff Traitor'''. **However, do note that at later waves some '''Redcliff Traitors''' spawn with the stun and freeze immunities, making freezing and stunning less effective against them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} RedcliffTraitorSprint.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheHuntThumbnail.png|'''Redcliff Traitor''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} TheHuntThumbnailClean.png|'''Redcliff Traitor''' on a render. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Redcliff Traitor''' references the rivalry between the [[w:c:Roblox:Knights of RedCliff|Knights of RedCliff]] and [[w:c:Roblox:Korblox's Empire|Korblox's Empire]]. **Historically, members who defected to other factions, or were simply banished are called Renegades. ==Update History== *'''15 March 2024''' - [[v1.16.0]] **'''Redcliff Traitor''' added. *'''30 March 2024''' - [[v1.17.0]]a **'''Redcliff Traitor''' removed. {{TheHunt|[[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt)|Korblox Warrior]]|Wave 4|Redcliff Traitor|Wave 6|[[Korblox General (The Hunt)|Korblox General]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Redcliff Traitor}}
